s.t:
Directeur/trice Planification et Production Façades
Leader sur le marché des façades high\-tech et de la construction métallique en Suisse avec plus de 550 collaborateurs, Sottas SA est une entreprise familiale fiable, à la pointe de la technologie, plaçant l’être humain au centre.
Nous sommes reconnus pour notre know\-how et notre respect des engagements de haut niveau en termes de qualité, délais, sécurité et développement durable.
Directeur/trice Planification et Production Façades
Description du poste
Afin d’assurer la planification et la direction de notre production de Façades, nous recherchons notre futur/e directeur/trice qui collaborera étroitement avec les directeurs d’exécution et les services partagés, dont les responsabilités principales seront :
Le management direct des responsables de sites (Bulle et Denges), eux\-mêmes en charge de la gestion opérationnelle complète des ateliers, et leur coordination
La planification de la charge macro du département, en collaboration avec le reste de la direction (commerciale, exécution, et services)
La gestion de la sous\-traitance (décision, budget, organisation, conformité)
Le développement commercial de la production, notamment des offres de prestations selon notre capacité disponible et optimisation de l’exploitation des infrastructures
La participation active aux projets d’amélioration et d’innovation
Le pilotage stratégique de la production : définition et suivi des objectifs, contribuant aux intérêts généraux de l’entreprise, décisions des ressources, collaboration aux investissements

Pour relever ce défi, vous êtes reconnu/e pour vos compétences organisationnelles pragmatiques. Vous êtes à même de considérer les aspects propres à une production de projets allant de pièces uniques à des séries prototypées, en veillant aux exigences de toute fabrication en matière de sécurité, de qualité et de délais. Dans cette fonction au centre de la chaîne de valeur de l’entreprise, vous vivez et prônez la collaboration avec les autres secteurs.
Résolument orienté/e vers l’avenir, vous cherchez toujours à améliorer la production, que ce soit en termes de compétences, d’outils, de technologie ou d’utilisation des ressources (humaines, énergétiques, matérielles).
Votre analyse pertinente et correcte des éléments en jeu vous permet de prendre des décisions dans l’intérêt de l’entreprise et de réagir et vous adapter aux situations prévues ou imprévues. Pour cela, vous faites preuve d’anticipation et de considération de tous les départements, et communiquez de ère claire et transparente avec les personnes et secteurs impliqués.
Grâce à vos équipes, vous êtes en mesure de satisfaire vos clients internes afin de réaliser les projets Sottas et satisfaire nos clients externes.
Afin d'assurer le rôle technique du poste, vous possédez les caractéristiques suivantes:
Vous êtes expert des environnements de production, avec une très bonne compréhension de la supply chain, et l’expérience d’amélioration continue en contexte de production (type lean management)
Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d’ingénieur de production ou autre formation équivalente
Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques usuels, et êtes expérimenté dans l’exploitation d’un ERP et/ou d’un MES
Informations complémentaires
Vous avez envie de vous épanouir professionnellement, de relever des défis techniques et de participer à des projets de grande envergure ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature (avec diplômes et certificats de travail).

## Firmenbeschreibung ##
Actif dans la construction métallique et reconnu dans toute la Suisse romande, notre client basé dans le canton de Fribourg renforce ses équipes. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons des monteurs / monteuses façades métalliques (H/F/D) à 100 %, prêts à s-investir sur des projets variés et techniques.
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
* Montage et installation de façades métalliques sur différents chantiers
* Pose d-éléments de bardage, structures et enveloppes de bâtiments
* Lecture et interprétation de plans techniques
* Travaux de finition et ajustements sur site
* Respect des normes de sécurité et des délais
* Collaboration avec les équipes de montage et de chantier
## Wir erwarten ##
* Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation CFC ou vous avez une expérience significative dans le domaine.
* Vous avez plusieurs années d'expérience dans la pose de façades et possédez un permis de conduire.
* Le permis de nacelle est un atout.
* Vous êtes capable de travailler de manière autonome et vous êtes une personne fiable.
* De plus, vous avez de bonnes connaissances en français, ce qui vous permettra de communiquer efficacement avec votre équipe.
## Wir bieten ##
* Un poste stable à 100 % au sein d-une entreprise reconnue
* Des projets variés et techniques
* Un environnement de travail dynamique et professionnel
* Des conditions attractives selon expérience
* Possibilités de missions longues durées

Nexii designs and manufactures innovative, sustainable building products that enable rapid construction while significantly reducing environmental impact. Our solutions help build healthier, more durable, and sustainable structures for a better future. Independently represent and promote the manufacturer’s products within an assigned territory, communicating product features, specifications, and applicable standards accurately
Develop and manage professional relationships with architects, contractors, developers, property owners, and other key decision-makers
Identify, pursue, and support project opportunities to meet mutually agreed-upon annual sales and specification objectives

Participate in trade shows, industry events, and networking activities at your discretion to support business development efforts
Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, and sales activities using the manufacturer’s CRM or reporting tools
Provide periodic updates on sales activity, pipeline status, and market feedback to support collaboration and forecasting

10+ years of experience in business development or as sales agent within the construction or building materials industry with existing relationships with architects, contractors, developers and owners.
Strong understanding of construction processes, materials procurement, and sustainable building practices.
Familiarity with sustainable building technologies, LEED, or similar frameworks.
Proven ability to drive specifications and revenue growth and close large-scale deals.
Exceptional negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.
Self-motivated with entrepreneurial mindset.
Flexible, independent work structure.

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, or a related field.
Experience working with CRM systems and sales analytics tools.
Knowledge of sustainable building practices and green building technologies.
If you are a motivated, results-driven sales professional eager to join a dynamic and innovative company, we encourage you to apply!

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.
Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.
At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.
Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Role can be based in any of our UK offices.
Jensen Hughes is a company fiercely committed to our purpose, our clients, and each other. Every single member of our team is essential to our success. Due to the continued growth and success of our External Walls and Facades team, we have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Director: Facades to join our market leading UK team.
This role provides senior technical leadership across façade and external wall projects, bridging deep technical expertise with team leadership, quality assurance, and client engagement. You will work closely with the Director of Facades, an additional Technical Director, the Facades team, and the wider Fire Engineering leadership to support the delivery and growth of our façade consultancy services across the UK.
The Impact You’ll Make in This Role
The successful candidate will provide senior technical leadership and governance across façade and external wall engineering services. The role is responsible for ensuring technical excellence, appropriate risk management, and defensible engineering judgement on complex and high-risk projects.
The successful candidate will act as a recognized internal technical authority, supporting project delivery teams, mentoring engineers, and representing Jensen Hughes in senior technical discussions with clients and stakeholders.
You will continue to be involved in technically complex projects while also supporting team development, workload management, and consistency of delivery across offices. This role is ideal for a highly experienced façade consultant who enjoys remaining technically engaged while influencing standards, people, and outcomes.

Act as a senior technical authority for façade and external wall systems, including fire performance, testing, appraisal, and remediation strategies.
Provide technical oversight, peer review, and sign-off for complex and high-risk façade deliverables.
Ensure façade engineering advice is proportionate, risk-based, and aligned with relevant legislation, guidance, and internal governance requirements.
Lead the technical approach on complex façade and external wall appointments.
Represent Jensen Hughes in senior technical discussions with clients, design teams, contractors, and regulators.
Identify, assess, and manage technical risk across façade and external wall projects.
Support the development and application of internal technical standards, guidance notes, and quality assurance processes.
Mentor and support engineers across the façade and external wall team, contributing to capability development and performance review.
Support the Director – Facades in service line development, including technical input to fee strategy, workload planning, and resourcing.
Contribute to maintaining Jensen Hughes’ reputation for high-quality, independent technical advice.

s.h: If successful, here is what we will expect from you
s.t:
Delivery of high-quality, defensible technical advice on complex projects.
Effective technical governance, peer review, and risk management.
Positive client feedback and repeat appointments.
Demonstrated development and progression of technical staff.
Contribution to the strength and credibility of the façade and external wall service line.

Degree qualified in Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent demonstrable experience).
Chartered or working towards chartership (desirable).
Extensive experience in façade and/or external wall engineering.
Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgement on complex and high-risk projects.
Strong understanding of façade systems, materials, construction techniques, and performance.
Experience in technical governance, peer review, and quality assurance.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly to clients and stakeholders.
Experience mentoring and supporting engineers at varying levels.
Willingness to travel to project sites across the UK as required.

Jensen Hughes is a company fiercely committed to our purpose, our clients, and each other. Every single member of our team is essential to our success. Due to the continued growth and success of our External Walls and Facades team, we have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Engineer to join our market leading UK team.
As a Principal Engineer, you will provide advanced technical delivery and project leadership across façade engineering and external wall fire consultancy services, you will be responsible for exercising independent engineering judgement on complex projects, leading technical workstreams, and ensuring that deliverables are technically robust, proportionate, and defensible.

You will be a senior technical contributor within project teams, support quality assurance and peer review processes, mentor developing engineers, and contribute to maintaining Jensen Hughes’ reputation for high-quality, risk-based advice.

Lead technical delivery on façade and external wall projects of moderate to high complexity.
Exercise independent engineering judgement in relation to façade systems, fire performance, remediation strategies, and compliance pathways.
Prepare and oversee the preparation of external wall fire assessment reports (e.g. PAS 9980 appraisals), façade engineering reports, and technical notes.
Review façade build-ups, materials, fire stopping provisions, cavity barriers, and remediation proposals.
Assess test evidence, classification reports, product certifications, and desktop studies.
Identify technical risks and develop proportionate mitigation strategies.
Act as day-to-day technical lead on allocated projects.
Lead technical discussions with clients, architects, contractors, and multidisciplinary design teams.
Provide clear, structured technical advice aligned with legislation, statutory guidance, and industry standards.

s.h: If successful, here is what we will expect from you
s.t:
Operate with increasing independence in technical judgement.
Demonstrate commercial awareness in project delivery.
Show readiness to transition toward Associate-level leadership responsibilities.
Build recognised technical credibility internally and externally.
Contribute to strengthening Jensen Hughes’ façade and external wall capability.

Degree qualified in Engineering, Architecture, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent demonstrable experience).
Chartered or actively working towards chartership (strongly preferred).
Significant experience in façade engineering and/or external wall fire consultancy.
Strong understanding of façade systems, construction methods, and performance requirements.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams independently.
Experience in preparing and reviewing PAS 9980 appraisals or similar risk-based assessments.
Strong report writing capability and structured technical reasoning.
Experience mentoring junior engineers.
Clear communication skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
